text:
Sam: repro in staging: prefetch workers + eviction sweeps end up in a circular wait under aggressive demote. stack gist: ```prefetch.lock(shard)
evict.lock(tenant)
evict.wait(prefetch)
prefetch.wait(evict) // cycle```
Alisha: link?
Sam: https://gist.github.com/trace123
Ben: inverted lock ordering. options: flip ordering, steal-RPC, or read-mode tenant lock.
Chen: flip ordering easiest but may widen critical path.
Alisha: steal RPC (StealPrefix) avoids global reorders but needs idempotent handoff.
Maria: short mitigation: bounded-wait + requeue eviction; pair with tighter eviction budget.
Kai: i'll run perf matrix (lock-flip vs steal vs read-mode) with prefetch conc 1..8 and demote 2/10/30s.
Ben: i'll draft proto + failure modes.
Chen: i'll prototype try-upgrade read->write with backoff.
Alisha: i'll add telemetry sampling "lock_wait_chain" (sample when blocked >5ms) and a staging canary.
evict-bot: created INF-2345 and INF-2346
Sam: recap actions and meet tomorrow.
